{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sample_seq > 1 (retests)
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique().gt(1).sum()}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for assay_batch
print(f"Assay batch distribution: {df['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check arm and severity
print(f"Arm distribution: {df['arm'].value_counts().to_dict()}")
print(f"Severity distribution: {df['severity'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check if arm is associated with severity
print(f"Cross-tab: arm vs severity\n{pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])}")"}
